rows.label: Project
rows.value: Agate Beach County Park Shoreline Restoration

rows.label: What the project is
rows.value: Remove rock shore armor and other associated debris across two reaches totaling approximately 552 lineal feet (LF) of beach at Agate Beach County Park and the neighboring property to the south. An estimated 1,600 CY (approximately 2,330 tons) of rock will be removed from the beach as part of this project. Will include beach and backshore cleanup, beach nourishment, vegetation enhancement, and the construction of new stairs to the beach.
